verdict.rationale: Sprinto's docs claim live dashboards showing compliance posture, multi-framework management, and continuous monitoring to keep audit readiness. A 'Framework Health' API page suggests some per-framework health metric. None of the evidence actually describes a readiness view that breaks down passing controls versus open gaps per framework as a single percentage. Missing for 10: documented per-framework readiness percentage, explicit passing-vs-failing control counts, a remaining-work breakdown, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
